change_summary: Remove the persistent left sidebar across all internal product screens.
Remove persistent right-side information rails from primary working screens.
Move global navigation into a compact top navigation bar.
Use the recovered horizontal space to create a wider, calmer central working canvas.
Prefer inline, contextual, collapsible, drawer or modal presentation for secondary information.
Campaign detail remains an infinite vertical canvas of angle groups and Facebook-like ad cards.

product_design_principle.secondary: The working object should occupy the interface, not navigation or metadata chrome.
product_design_principle.interface_rule: Persistent UI should only remain visible if it is used frequently enough to justify permanent space.

implementation_note: This manifest is a global layout pivot. It overrides earlier shell/navigation/right-rail decisions while preserving the existing Sorted Ads product model, campaign hierarchy, testing rules, status semantics and overall Sorted visual language.

typography.font_family: Use the same modern grotesk / sans family used by Sorted. Fallback: Inter, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif.

left_sidebar.rule: Do not reserve horizontal space for a persistent left rail.

right_sidebar.rule: Do not reserve persistent horizontal space for campaign metadata, metrics or helper panels.

workspace_selector.placement: below nav in page header or compactly near page title
workspace_selector.rule: Do not let workspace switching dominate the top navigation.

main_canvas.rule: Use the full recovered width for the content itself.

campaign_context_navigation.rule: Campaign-specific tasks should be reachable through obvious page actions and global nav, not another always-visible rail.

secondary_information_strategy.campaign_progress: Display as compact inline summary near the page header, within filter/status rows, or on demand via lightweight popover.
secondary_information_strategy.campaign_details: Display in an Edit Campaign modal/drawer opened from the header.
secondary_information_strategy.target_audience: Show as compact metadata under campaign title; full detail in campaign settings modal/drawer.
secondary_information_strategy.channels: Show as compact metadata under campaign title or within publish flow.
secondary_information_strategy.goal: Show as one-line campaign description under title; full editable detail in campaign settings.
secondary_information_strategy.dates: Show in campaign metadata line; edit through campaign settings.
secondary_information_strategy.help: Use a small help/support item in top-nav account menu or unobtrusive floating help control; do not permanently reserve a card.

campaign_detail_canonical_layout.screen_role: Primary working canvas for campaign editing, review and collaboration.

row_1: workspace selector or compact workspace identity
campaign actions on right: overflow, Share, Publish campaign

filter_bar.rule: Filters operate on the current campaign page; never route to separate pages.

header: summary counts: approved / in review / draft
angle_group.testing_rule: All three variants use the same underlying creative for valid copy-length testing.
angle_group.card_style: Facebook-like ad mimic rather than generic form editor.
angle_group.height_rule: Allow each ad card to grow naturally with its copy. The angle section height is determined by the tallest ad card in that row.
angle_group.next_angle: Begins below the tallest card in the previous angle group.

view_mode.goal: The normal state should visually resemble the platform ad enough that no separate preview page is needed.

edit_mode.trigger: pencil icon on the individual Short / Medium / Long ad
edit_mode.behavior: Switch this card in place into edit mode. Do not navigate and do not open a full-screen editor.

creative_edit.trigger: click or hover action on the creative while in edit mode
creative_edit.warning: Changing the creative changes it for Short, Medium and Long because the creative belongs to the angle.

edit_mode.success_feedback: small temporary saved toast, not a persistent panel

comments.behavior: Expand inline below the card or use a lightweight drawer/popover.
comments.rule: Do not create an individual review page.

campaign_index.layout: wide centered card grid beneath top nav

assets.inspector_behavior: temporary right drawer only when an asset is selected; it is not a persistent page rail

publishing.summary: Use an inline summary panel within the flow or collapsible review section, not a persistent right rail.

results.performance_metrics: Place percentage metrics in a top or inline grid beside/under headline metrics instead of a persistent right column.
results.channel_breakdown: Inline card/grid beneath or beside metrics where space allows.

client_review.rule: Remain an intentionally stripped-down external review surface.

tablet.top_nav: compact horizontal nav or overflow menu

mobile.variants: Short, Medium and Long may stack vertically or use a segmented control while remaining on the same campaign page.
mobile.rule: Do not restore a persistent sidebar at smaller widths.

explicitly_remove: Permanent help card occupying page width
Route-level pages for individual copy variants
do_not_reinterpret: Removing the right rail does not mean removing campaign progress or metadata; move them into compact contextual locations.
Removing the left sidebar does not remove navigation; navigation moves to the top.
Facebook-like ad cards are the primary view and preview. Editing happens in place.
Short, Medium and Long remain separate copy variants under one angle.
Creative remains shared across all three copy-length variants.
Infinite vertical scrolling is intentional and preferred over compressing all angles into one viewport.
